passages.name: CharGen
passages.source_raw: \ You find yourself once again in the interrogation room with the two federal agents. They've got that tired look on their faces, well, of course, you've been here before. - "Well, here we are again," one of the agents sighs, rubbing his forehead. "You manage to get yourself caught, and now we have to bail you out... again. But this time, it’s different." You raised an eyebrow in surprise. - "We'll get to it in no time. Let's do a rundown on your criminal records first, you know, usual stuff." the second agent pulls out a thick folder from the stack of papers on the table, flipping it open with a slight rustle. He looks at the pages for a moment, eyes scanning the text, before giving you a knowing glance. "Here we go. Your history's all laid out. Correct me if i'm wrong." <> By default, all your stats start at 3. You also have energy, which limits the number of actions you can take daily. However, it only restricts particularly time-consuming actions, not all profitable ones. You can increase your energy through certain traits or by purchasing an expensive car. Combat - measures your attack damage in combat encounters. It allows you to achieve what you want with brute force. Can be raised by participating in combat or by attending expensive combat training courses. Cunning - measures how agile and tricky you are. It’s your ability to sell more and achieve whatever you want through deception and lies. Cunning affects the amount of money you earn from various activities, not just criminal ones. You can raise it with the help of traits that you earn by engaging in illegal activities. Charm - your looks and overall allure. It allows you to achieve whatever you want through seduction and charisma. Determines how quickly you can form friendships and influences how much money you can earn from activities where your presentation matters. You can raise it by wearing expensive clothing and acquiring traits that enhance your attractiveness. /*
	Date & Time Widget Setup
*/
<<set
	window.GameDays to [
		"Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"
	];
	window.GameMonths to [
		"Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
		"Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"
	];
	$gameDate to new Date(Date.UTC(2010, 5, 1, 8, 0))
>>

	/*
		Below we have to use the multi-parameter version of the Date
		constructor, rather than the date string version, because the
		date string version treats a missing timezone offset as UTC.
		While there are ways to determine players' timezone offsets,
		so they could be added to a date string, it's more convenient
		simply to use the multi-parameter constructor.

		The point of this is so that you can simply initialize the game
		world clock to whatever date and time you wish without having to
		worry about the players' timezone offsets, while still ensuring
		that they all see the same game world dates and times.
	*/
	/* params: year , month(0-based) , day , hour(24H) , minute [, second ] */


/*
	Date & Time Advancement Widget Definitions
*/
<<widget "addmins">>\
	<<run $gameDate.setUTCMinutes($gameDate.getUTCMinutes() + $args[0])>>\
    <<if !tags().includes("sex")>>\
        <<set $arousal_tick += $args[0]>>\
        <<if $arousal_tick >= 60>>\
            <<processArousal>>\
        <</if>>\
    <</if>>\
<</widget>>

<<widget "addhours">>\
	<<run $gameDate.setUTCHours($gameDate.getUTCHours() + $args[0])>>\
    <<if !tags().includes("sex")>>\
        <<set $arousal_tick += $args[0] * 60>>\
        <<processArousal>>\
    <</if>>\
<</widget>>

<<widget "adddays">>\
	<<run $gameDate.setUTCHours($gameDate.getUTCHours() + ($args[0] * 24))>>\
<</widget>>

/*
	Date & Time Printing Widget Definitions
*/
/* Prints the current date ("{weekday} {month} {day}, {year}"). */
<<widget "date">>\
<<print String.format("{0} {1} {2}",
	GameDays[$gameDate.getUTCDay()],
	GameMonths[$gameDate.getUTCMonth()],
	$gameDate.getUTCDate()
)>>\
<</widget>>

/* Prints the current time (12H). */
<<widget "time12hr">>\
<<set _h to $gameDate.getUTCHours()>>
<<if _h eq 0>>\
12\
<<elseif _h gt 12>>\
<<print _h - 12>>\
<<else>>\
<<print _h>>\
<</if>>:\

<<if $gameDate.getUTCMinutes() lt 10>>0<</if>><<print $gameDate.getUTCMinutes()>> \
<<if _h gte 12>>PM<<else>>AM<</if>>\
<</widget>>

/* Prints the current time (24H). */
<<widget "time24hr">>\
<<if $gameDate.getUTCHours() lt 10>>0<</if>><<print $gameDate.getUTCHours()>>:\
<<if $gameDate.getUTCMinutes() lt 10>>0<</if>><<print $gameDate.getUTCMinutes()>>\
<</widget>>

/* Prints the current date and time (12H). */
<<widget "datetime">><<date>> <<time12hr>> (<<time24hr>>)<</widget>>
  
 /* To advance the time 5 minutes in a passage, type <<addmins 5>> somewhere into the passage.
To advance 7 hours, <<addhours 7>>
To advance 30 days, <<adddays 30>>*/

<</button>>*/

passages.name: Item Definitions
passages.source_raw:
<<item "Cell phone" "outdated cell phone">>
	<<description>>
        A very outdated and old cell phone - it’s really not worth the hassle. It’ll be hilarious if you get yourself arrested for this. You’re not even sure how to use it...
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Smartphone" "Smart">>
    <<description>>
    That’s your basic smartphone. Being a smart robber, you’ve already taken the battery out - no way you're risking it with all the modern surveillance and detection systems. Leave this problem to someone who cares enough to pay you for this brick.
    <</item>>
    
<<consumable "Wallet" "Wallet">>
	<<set _random_money = random(5, 110) * $cun>>
	<<money `_random_money`>>
    <<notify_log 3s>>You've got _random_money bucks!<</notify_log>>
	<<description>>\ 
    You want to open it. Open it. Open.
    <</consumable>>
    
<<item "Lockpick" "Lockpick">>
	<<description>>
    A tool that screams "open sesame." A tool for bad people - people like you. Do what comes natural.
<</item>>

<<item "Golden Ring" "Golden Ring">>
	<<description>>
    This ring might have meant something to someone you never knew. But if you start thinking about it, your conscience might wake up. Now it's yours, and that's all that matters. Anyway, someone who can afford a golden ring can easily buy a new one.
    You may use this item as a gift.
<</item>>

<<item "Silver Ring" "Silver Ring">>
	<<description>>
    This ring might have meant something to someone you never knew. But if you start thinking about it, your conscience might wake up. Now it's yours, and that's all that matters.
    You may use this item as a gift.
<</item>>

<<item "Golden Chain" "Golden Chain">>
	<<description>>
    18 karat golden chain. It’s too big and impractical; it was created purely for showing off. It's for the best that you have this chain - one less "fashion" victim in the world.
    You may use this item as a gift.
<</item>>

<<item "Precious Necklace" "Precious Necklace">>
	<<description>>
     An elegant, glittering necklace that definitely belonged to someone who calls their dog "sweetie." It probably saw more gala dinners than you’ve seen hot meals. Now it's going to see the inside of your pocket. That's what we call social justice.
     You may use this item as a gift.
<</item>>

<<item "Junk" "Junk">>
	<<description>>
    Just junk. A lot of useless things, you may try to sell it on the market, you little stinky hoarder.
<</item>>

<<item "Strange Note#1" "Strange Note #1">>
	<<description>>
   1. If you lost something important - like this //very important// note - you always can buy it in pawnshop! But, of course, you must find it at first. Also, you can put all notes on the whiteboard at home, you just need to have it in your stash or pockets!
    2. If you somehow got yourself in troubles - remember to watch over your health and endurance. No one is able to stand on their feet after a good beating.
    3. Speaking of which, your battery will die if you're gonna work, whatever your work is. Anything else? Go nuts. But the second you try earning some money, you’re on the clock. 
    P.S. 
    Look for other notes in various places! Even in those that are closed in specific time of day.
    P.P.S.
    If you feel like you're lacking the skills for the job, just keep at it - one day, you'll get better. This applies to everything.
    <<unique>>
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Strange Note#2" "Strange Note #2">>
	<<description>>
   4. Rumours says that there's a secret gang of hackers in a suburbs area. This gang offers a various information and skills for the one who seeks it.
   5. Car allows you to travel much faster and significantly more easily, like, literally just by wishing when and where you wanna ride. If you tired of constant moving between districts - get a car! Its too obvious, yeah?
   6. Riddle: What can you find on a woman's body, a hockey field, and a chessboard?... Answer: A combination! Some clothes are more provocative, while others are more elegant. Both styles will raise your charm the more you stack up. And of course, you can always combine styles to your liking.
   7. By the way, about clothes - shop offers are not always the same. Variety of wares is going to change. Just something big enough should happen.
   <<unique>>
   <</item>>
   
<<item "Strange Note#3" "Strange Note#3">>
	<<description>>
   8. Have you ever thought about a trading business? Its quite easy, mind you! You just need: 
   1) find a place to store your cargo, warehouse preferably;
   2) prepare your cargo, you may wanna do it right in a storage place i've mentioned previously! (it's more convenient to do) - for that you need to have a considerable amount of your wares, something like 100 pcs!;
   3) find a distributor! It might be some dropshipper or a large-quantity distributing services provider.
   P.S. You don't really have to pack your wares into cargo, if you are a small trader it might be wiser to work on your connection and a first capital! Just don't forget to turn your capital into more profit.
   9. If you are true dealer - don't be ashamed of trying to sell something in unconventional places! Even in places like gym and various clubs - develop your business skills everywhere!
   10. Streets are peculiarly full of illegal chemical substances nowadays. I wonder, from where do ghetto chemists are getting their supplements? I can imagine you can get some of it on the market, but i dunno how you can get chemical materials for such things without connections in pharmaceuticals circles... or without skills in theft, i guess?
    <<unique>>
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Strange Note#4" "Strange Note#4">>
	<<description>>
	11. Whenever a new party spot opens in the city, it gets an initial surge in popularity! Well, it's not some big secret - it works the same way with everything in life. But the novelty effect fades quickly.. 
    12. Speaking of which, if this place, figuratively speaking, is stocked with everything it has to offer, it will continue to steadily gain popularity over time!
    13. Higher popularity brings more problems. Isn’t that obvious? It can hurt your reputation and even lead to losses, and more popular the place bigger the losses.
    14. Higher popularity also increases demand for the products you offer. So, the more popular your place, the higher the demand for your goods, and ultimately, the more profit that goes into replenishing your stock.
    <<unique>>
    <</item>>
    
 <<item "Block 19" "Block 19">>
 	<<description>>
    A handgun. A loyal tool for your operation. Easy to hide, even easier to use. Perfect for when you need to "build" a solid argument in your favor - one block at a time. Just don't carry it anywhere while high profile, it wouldnt be very wise.
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Saga-12" "Saga-12">>
	<<description>>
    A shotgun. One of the best tools if you're going in personal. It'll turn any skirmish into an epic saga. Just don't carry it anywhere while high profile, it wouldnt be very wise.
    <</item>>
    
<<item "I16" "I16">>
	<<description>>
    Decommissioned service rifle. Now it's gonna service you, who woulda knew? "I" stands for "Intimidation". Just don't carry it anywhere while high profile, it wouldnt be very wise.
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Junk Handgun" "Junk Handgun">>
	<<description>>
    A crude handgun assembled from scrap and stubbornness. It rattles a little when you shake it - which you probably shouldn't. Surprisingly functional, surprisingly illegal. 
    <</item>>\

<<item "Junk Rifle" "Junk Rifle">>
	<<description>>
    A smoothbore rifle built from salvaged pipes and improvised parts. Not elegant. Not precise. But it sends a very clear message at close range. 
    <</item>>\

<<item "Junk Autogun" "Junk Autogun">>
	<<description>>
    A fully automatic abomination stitched together with pipes. Loud, temperamental and hungry for ammo. Weird stuff.
    <</item>>\
    
<<item "Handheld Taser" "Handheld Taser">>
	<<description>>
    Easy to take out, even easier to use, just shoot from the right side. Will help you to defend in case of unwanted attention. One time use.
    <</item>>\
    
<<item "Safe-cracking kit" "Safecracking kit">>
	<<description>>
    Everything you need for some safe-cracking.
    <<unique>>
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Car Opening Tools" "Car Opening Tools">>
	<<description>>
    Hooks and handles of various diameters that will help you with your shady business. No, sadly it's not a valid tool for a burglary.
	<</item>>
    
<<item "Crypto Farm Kit" "Crypto Farm Kit">>
 	<<description>>
    A bunch of GPUs stitched together in somekind of frame. Sixth left installation instruction on the back of it, tldr - set this up in a cool place and connect the wires to your computer... and get your money. Magic, i guess?
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Gold Bar" "Gold Bar">>
 	<<description>>
    A solid reminder that crime does pay - just not in small bills. Its too shiny to ignore and too traceable to sell.
    <</item>>
    
/* Cars */

<<item "Muscle Car" "Muscle Car">>
	<<description>>
    Beast from 80-s. Don't forget your sunglasses and a sidekick.
    <</item>>
    
<<item "SUV Car" "SUV Car">>
	<<description>>
    Best friend of modern adventurers, survivalists and people who are compensating for something. 
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Pickup Truck" "Pickup Truck">>
	<<description>>
    Your working horse. Helps you if you wanna have a party, or you're working as a porter or even if you need to finish a some deals.
    <</item>>
   
<<item "Sedan Car" "Sedan Car">>
	<<description>>
    Default car. Like, literally. Your basic car for all purposes. Just don't forget about clearing it first.
    <</item>>

<<item "Porter Car" "Porter Car">>
	<<description>>
    Not the most elegant way to move around on vehicle, you'll gonna feel every hillock, every hummock and tussock. But... it'll do its job.
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Van Car" "Van Car">>
	<<description>>
    You either afraid of these type of cars or laugh at it. Make it former.
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Sportcar" "Sportcar">>
	<<description>>
    Swag. 
    <</item>>
    
/* Craft */

<<item "Chems A" "Chems A">>
	<<description>>
    Various chemical substances for your chemistry. Don't forget about safety controls!
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Chems B" "Chems B">>
	<<description>>
    Other various chemical substances for your chemistry. Don't forget about safety controls!
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Organic Materials" "Organic Materials">>
	<<description>>
    Everything that consists of organic compound, i.e. carbon-based. Don't forget about safety controls!
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Agricultural Products" "Agricultural Products">>
	<<description>>
    Yeast, barley, lot of protein-based provision and various nutriments and other very important things right from our hard workers in agricultural sphere. 
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Materials for Encapsulation" "Materials for Encapsulation">>
	<<description>>
    Various things like gelatin and gums for your chemistry results. Don't forget about safety controls!
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Paper" "Paper">>
	<<description>>
    "Where's our map? - I've blow it up!"
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Electrical Components" "Electrical Components">>
	<<description>>
    Various electronic and technical gizmos that are beyond your area of expertise.
    <</item>>
    
<<item "Gun Parts" "Gun Parts">>
	<<description>>
    Assorted mechanical components stripped, filed, and repurposed from scrap. Springs, barrels, triggers, bolts - nothing fancy, but functional.
    On their own, they're just metal. For now. Right?
    <</item>>
    
/* Drugs */
    
<<consumable "Aphrodisiac" "Aphrodisiac">>
	<<arousal `random(20, 35)`>>
    <<notify_log 3s>>Fun stuff. Yum.<</notify_log>>
	<<description>>\ 
    New drug that makes everyone horny. Even you. Especially you. So don't you even try that. It looks like a pink pills, insides of it contain some flavoured powder, smells like strawberries.
    You may use this item as a gift.
<</consumable>>
    
<<item "Drugs" "Drugs">>

If you wanna be magic.

<style>
	body.downtown::before {
    content: '';
     background-image: url("img/background/downtown/marketplace.webp");
     inset: 0;
     position: fixed;
     mask-image: linear-gradient(to top left, black 52%, transparent 56%);
     background-size: cover;

Hands slip through the chaos like ghosts - one distraction, one quick move, and someone's lighter on cash. The market noise drowns out everything, but not the weight of a fresh score in your pocket.
<<set _result = random(1, 20)>>\
    <<if _result > 7 - $cun/2>>\
    	<<if $p_traits.includes("pickpocketer")>>\
          <<set _random_1 = $marketplace.array.random()>>\
          <<set _random_2 = $marketplace.array.random()>>\
          <<pickup $p_inv _random_1 1>>\
          <<pickup $p_inv _random_2 1>>\
              You've got _random_1 from first belt and _random_2 from the second one!
       <<link "Let's get back to hustling" "Marketplace">>
          <<pickpocketing_success>>\
       <</link>>
       <<else>>       /*if doesnt have a trait*/\
           <<set _random_1 = $marketplace.array.random()>>\
            <<pickup $p_inv _random_1 1>>\
                You've got _random_1!
       <<link "Let's get back to hustling" "Marketplace">>
       		<<pickpocketing_success>>\
       <</link>>
         <</if>>\
<<else>>\
	<<pickpocketing_fail>>\
	<<goto "Caught Market Stealing">>\
<</if>>\

passages.name: Counting Widgets
passages.source_raw:
<<widget "money">>\
  <<set $money = Math.clamp($money + _args[0], 0, Infinity)>>\
  <<replace "#money">><<= $money>>$<</replace>>\
    <<if _args[0] > 0>>\
		<<set $stat_money += _args[0]>>\
	<<elseif _args[0] < 0>>\
    	<<set $stat_money_used -= _args[0]>>\
    <</if>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "money_undeposit">>\
    <<set $money = Math.clamp($money + _args[0], 0, Infinity)>>\
    <<replace "#money">><<= $money>>$<</replace>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "money_deposit">>\
    <<set $money_deposit = Math.clamp($money_deposit + _args[0], 0, Infinity)>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "moneynoreplace">>\
	<<set $money = Math.clamp($money + _args[0], 0, Infinity)>>\
    <<if _args[0] > 0>>\
		<<set $stat_money += _args[0]>>\
	<<elseif _args[0] < 0>>\
    	<<set $stat_money_used -= _args[0]>>\
    <</if>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "heat">>\
<<silently>>\
<<set _heat_check = $heat>>\
<<if $heat_difficulty == "Default">>
	<<set $heat = Math.clamp($heat + _args[0], 0, 125)>>\
    <<if _args[0] > 0>>\
    	<<set $stat_heat += _args[0]>>\
    <</if>>\
<<elseif $heat_difficulty == "Easy">>\
	<<if _args[0] < 0>>\
    	<<set $heat = Math.clamp($heat + _args[0], 0, 125)>>\
    <<elseif _args[0] > 0>>
        <<set _heat = _args[0]>>
        <<set _heat_reduced =  (_heat / 100) * 50>>
        <<set _heat_reduced = Math.trunc(_heat_reduced)>>
        <<set $heat = Math.clamp($heat + _heat_reduced, 0, 125)>>
        <<set $stat_heat += _heat_reduced>>\
    <</if>>
<</if>>\
<<if !tags().includes('endDay')>>
    <<if _heat_check < $heat && $heat_first > 0>>
            <<run triggerHeatEffect("heat-up")>>
    <<elseif _heat_check > $heat && $heat_first > 0>>
            <<run triggerHeatEffect("heat-down")>>
    <</if>>
<</if>>
<</silently>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "clock">>\
  <<run $gameDate.setUTCMinutes($gameDate.getUTCMinutes() + $args[0])>>\
  <<replace ".sidebar_time">><<time24hr>>\<</replace>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "dirty_money">>\
    <<set $dirty_money to Math.clamp($dirty_money + _args[0], 0, Infinity)>>\
<<if $dirty_money > 0>>\
    <<replace "#dirty_money">><<=$dirty_money>>$<</replace>> \
<</if>>\
    <<if _args[0] > 0>>\
		<<set $stat_dmoney += _args[0]>>\
	<<elseif _args[0] < 0>>\
    	<<set $stat_dmoney_used -= _args[0]>>\
    <</if>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "count_morale_change">>\
<<set _morale_change = ($band_morale_mod_bt + $band_morale_mod_payday + $band_universal_mod + $band_morale_nc)>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "active_npc_moral">>\
<<set $active_npc.moral = Math.clamp($active_npc.moral + _args[0], 0, 10)>>\
<<setNpc_fem>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "active_npc_friendship">>\
<<silently>>\
<<if $active_npc.special_trait == "Underdog" && $active_npc.offended == false>>
	<<if $reputation >= 10000>>
    	<<set $active_npc.friendship = Math.clamp($active_npc.friendship + _args[0], 0, 100)>>\
        <<set $active_npc.friendship = Math.clamp($active_npc.friendship + 5, 0, 100)>>\
        <<notify_log 4s>>Your companion's an underdog - your reputation makes them admire you.<</notify_log>>
    <<elseif $reputation < 10000>>\
    	<<set $active_npc.friendship = Math.clamp($active_npc.friendship + _args[0], 0, 100)>>\
        <<set $active_npc.friendship = Math.clamp($active_npc.friendship - 8, 0, 100)>>\
        <<notify_log 4s>>Your companion's an underdog - and they don't really like to hang out with someone who's not reputable.<</notify_log>>
	<</if>>\
<<elseif $active_npc.offended == false>>
	<<set $active_npc.friendship = Math.clamp($active_npc.friendship + _args[0], 0, 100)>>\
<<elseif $active_npc.offended == true>>\
	<<set $active_npc.friendship = 0>>\
<</if>>
<<if $active_npc.gender == 0>>
	<<setNpc>>
<<else>>
	<<setNpc_fem>>
<</if>>
<</silently>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "morale">>\
    <<set $band_morale = Math.clamp($band_morale + _args[0], 0, 100)>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "reputation_loss">>\
	<<set _change = _args[0] * $rep_loss_scale>>
	<<set $reputation = Math.clamp($reputation + _change, -100, Infinity)>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "nc_pop">>\
    <<set $nc_pop = Math.clamp($nc_pop + _args[0], 0, 100)>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "nc_capacity_drinks">>\

<</widget>>\

<</widget>>\

<<widget "brothel_capacity_aphrodisiac">>\
<<set $brothel_capacity_aphrodisiac = Math.clamp($brothel_capacity_aphrodisiac + _args[0], 0, 5000)>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "heist_progress">>\
    <<set $heist_progress = Math.clamp($heist_progress + _args[0], 0, $heist_progress_needed)>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "count_war_progress_speed">>\
<<if $gangs_war == true>>\
	<<set $band_enemy_strength = $gangs_str>>\
<<elseif $mafia_war == true>>\
	<<set $band_enemy_strength = $mafia_str>>\
<<elseif $bikers_war == true>>\
	<<set $band_enemy_strength = $bikers_str>>\
<</if>>\
<<set $band_war_progress_speed = Math.trunc(($band_strength - $band_enemy_strength) / 10)>>\
<<set $band_war_progress_speed = Math.clamp($band_war_progress_speed, 0, $band_war_max_progress)>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "add_war_progress">>\
  <<set $band_war_progress = Math.clamp($band_war_progress + _args[0], 0, $band_war_needed_progress)>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "mafia_str">>\
    <<set $mafia_str = Math.clamp($mafia_str + _args[0], 4000, 7500)>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "gangs_str">>\
    <<set $gangs_str = Math.clamp($gangs_str + _args[0], 1000, 4000)>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "bikers_str">>\
    <<set $bikers_str = Math.clamp($bikers_str + _args[0], 6500, 12500)>>\
<</widget>>\
    
<<widget "stam">>\
    <<set $stam = Math.clamp($stam + _args[0], 0, Infinity)>>\
    <<replace "#stam">><<= $stam>><</replace>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "roll">>\
	<<set _random = random(0, 20)>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "depravity">>\
<<silently>>\
    <<set $p_depravity = Math.clamp($p_depravity + _args[0], 0, 50)>>\
	<<if $p_depravity < 40>>
		<<set $arousal_max = 74>>
	<<else>>
		<<set $arousal_max = 100>>
	<</if>>
    <<set $p_max_pleasure = 50 + $p_depravity>>\
<</silently>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "active_npc_depravity">>\
<<silently>>\
    <<set $active_npc.depravity = Math.clamp($active_npc.depravity + _args[0], 0, 30)>>\
<</silently>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "active_npc_dom_30">>\
<<silently>>\
    <<set $active_npc.dom = Math.clamp($active_npc.dom + _args[0], 0, 30)>>\
<</silently>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "active_npc_dom_50">>\
<<silently>>\
    <<set $active_npc.dom = Math.clamp($active_npc.dom + _args[0], 0, 50)>>\
<</silently>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "rough_sex_check">>\
	<<if $rough_sex_attitude == "bad">>\
    	<<depravity `-1`>>\
        That was too rough for you.
    <<elseif $rough_sex_attitude == "ok">>\
    	<<depravity `1`>>\
    <<elseif $rough_sex_attitude == "like">>\
    	<<depravity `2`>>\
        That was rough... and you liked it!
    <</if>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "processArousal">>\
<<silently>>\
	<<set _hours = Math.floor($arousal_tick / 60)>>
	<<if _hours > 0>>
		<<for _i = 0; _i < _hours; _i++>>
			<<set _gain = 0>>
			<<if $p_depravity < 10>>
				<<set _gain = random(0, 1)>>
            <<elseif $p_depravity < 18>>\
            	<<set _gain = random(0, 2)>>
            <<elseif $p_depravity < 27>>
            	<<set _gain = random(1, 3)>>
			<<elseif $p_depravity < 37>>
				<<set _gain = random(2, 5)>>
			<<elseif $p_depravity < 45>>
				<<set _gain = random(3, 6)>>
			<<else>>
				<<set _gain = random(4, 6)>>
			<</if>>
			<<arousal `_gain`>>
		<</for>>
		<<set $arousal_tick -= _hours * 60>>
	<</if>>
<</silently>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "applyArousalMods">>
<<silently>>
	<<set $charm_arousal_mod = 0>>
	<<set $cun_arousal_mod = 0>>
	<<set $combat_arousal_mod = 0>>

	<<if $arousal_stage == 3>>
		<<set $charm_arousal_mod = 3>>
		<<set $cun_arousal_mod = -2>>
		<<set $combat_arousal_mod = -2>>
        <<run $("#arousalEffectStage3").show()>>
	<<elseif $arousal_stage == 2>>
		<<set $charm_arousal_mod = 2>>
		<<set $combat_arousal_mod = -2>>
        <<run $("#arousalEffectStage2").show()>>
	<<elseif $arousal_stage == 1>>
		<<set $charm_arousal_mod = 1>>
        <<run $("#arousalEffectStage1").show()>>
	<</if>>

	<<apply_charm>>
	<<apply_cunning>>
	<<apply_combat>>
<</silently>>
<</widget>>

<<widget "arousal">>\
<<silently>>\
    <<set $arousal = Math.clamp($arousal + _args[0], 0, $arousal_max)>>\
        <<set _newStage = 0>>
        <<if $arousal >= 85>>
        	<<set _newStage = 3>>
        <<elseif $arousal >= 55>>
        	<<set _newStage = 2>>
        <<elseif $arousal >= 25>>
        	<<set _newStage = 1>>
        <<elseif $arousal < 25>>
        	<<set _newStage = 0>>
        <</if>>
        
        <<if _newStage != $arousal_stage>>
        	<<set $arousal_stage = _newStage>>
        	<<applyArousalMods>>
        <</if>>
<</silently>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "arousingAction">>\
<<if $p_depravity >= 35>>\
	<<arousal `random(4, 9)`>>\
    <<notify_log 3s>>This kind of attention is quite thrilling...<</notify_log>>\
<</if>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "count_str">>\
<<set _amount_str = 0>>\
	<<for _i = 0; _i < $accomplices_list.length; _i = _i + 1>>\
	<<set _amount_str += $accomplices_list[_i].combat>>\
    <<set $band_strength = (_amount_str * 25) + $band_strength_bonus>>\
<</for>>
<</widget>>\

<<widget "band_payday">>\
<<set _band_payday = 0>>\
	<<for _i = 0; _i < $accomplices_list.length; _i = _i + 1>>\
        	<<if $accomplices_list[_i].pos>>\
            	<<switch $accomplices_list[_i].pos>>\
                <<case "Right Hand">>\
                	<<set _band_payday += 100 + $band_payment>>\
                <<case "Thief">>\
                	<<set _band_payday += 110 + $band_payment>>\
                <<case "Chauffeur">>\
                	<<set _band_payday += 70 + $band_payment>>\
                <<case "Scout">>\
                	<<set _band_payday += 120 + $band_payment>>\
                <<case "Drug Dealer">>\
                	<<set _band_payday += 200 + $band_payment>>\
                <<case "Steroid Dealer">>\
                	<<set _band_payday += 250 + $band_payment>>\
                <<case "Coin Washer">>\
                	<<set _band_payday += 135 + $band_payment>>\
                <<case "Hook">>\
                	<<if $hooks_on == true>>\
                		<<set _band_payday += 140 + $band_payment>>\
                    <</if>>\
                <<case "Damper">>\
                	<<set _band_payday += 400 + $band_payment>>\
                <<case "Booster">>\
                	<<set _band_payday += 285 + $band_payment>>\
                <<case "Racketeer">>\
                	<<set _band_payday += 210 + $band_payment>>\
                <<case "Yacht Trader">>\
                	<<set _band_payday += 150>>\
                <<case "Yacht Damper">>\

                <<case "Muscle">>\

                    <</if>>\
                <<case "Harbor Pimp">>\

                    <</if>>\
                <</switch>>\
        	<<else>>\
                <<set _band_payday += $band_payment>>\
            <</if>>\
	<</for>>
            <<set _band_payday = _band_payday * $morale_mod>>\
            <<set _band_payday = Math.trunc(_band_payday)>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "money_penalty">>\
	<<if $money >= 250000>>\

    	You've lost _money_random​$.\
    <<elseif $money >= 150000>>\

        You've lost _money_random​$.\
    <<elseif $money >= 100000>>\

        You've lost _money_random​$.\
    <<elseif $money >= 70000>>\

    <<elseif $money >= 40000>>\

    <<elseif $money >= 20000>>\

    <<elseif $money >= 10000>>\
    	<<set _money_random = random(1000, 3000)>>\
        You've lost _money_random​$.\
    <<elseif $money >= 5000>>\
    	<<set _money_random = random(500, 1500)>>\
        You've lost _money_random​$.\
    <<elseif $money >= 2000>>\

    <<else>>\

<</widget>>\

<<widget "warehouse_penalty">>\
	<<if $warehouse_inv.length >= 20>>\
    	<<set _lost_shipment_0 = either($warehouse_inv.array)>>\
        <<drop $warehouse_inv _lost_shipment_0 1>>\
    	<<set _lost_shipment_1 = either($warehouse_inv.array)>>\
        <<drop $warehouse_inv _lost_shipment_1 1>>\
    	<<set _lost_shipment_2 = either($warehouse_inv.array)>>\
        <<drop $warehouse_inv _lost_shipment_2 1>>\
    	<<set _lost_shipment_3 = either($warehouse_inv.array)>>\
        <<drop $warehouse_inv _lost_shipment_3 1>>\

passages.name: Strange Notes
passages.source_raw:
<<if $p_inv.has("Strange Note#1") || $stash.has("Strange Note#1")>>\
	1. If you lost something important - like this //very important// note - you always can buy it in pawnshop! But, of course, you must find it at first. Also, you can put all notes on the whiteboard at home, you just need to have it in your stash or pockets!
	2. If you somehow got yourself in troubles - remember to watch over your health and endurance. No one is able to stand on their feet after a good beating.
    3. Speaking of which, your battery will die if youre gonna work, whatever your work is. Anything else? Go nuts. But the second you try earning, you’re on the clock. 
	P.S. 
	Look for other notes in various places! Even in those that are closed in specific time of day.
    If you feel like you're lacking the skills for the job, just keep at it - one day, you'll get better. This applies to everything.
<</if>>\
<<if $p_inv.has("Strange Note#2") || $stash.has("Strange Note#2")>>
	4. Rumours says that there's a secret gang of hackers in a suburbs area. This gang offers a various information and skills for the one who seeks it.
	5. Car allows you to travel much faster and significantly more easily, like, literally just by wishing when and where you wanna ride. If you tired of constant moving between districts - get a car! Its too obvious, yeah?
	6. Riddle: What can you find on a woman's body, a hockey field, and a chessboard?... Answer: A combination! Some clothes are more provocative, while others are more elegant. Both styles will raise your charm the more you stack up. And of course, you can always combine styles to your liking.
	7. By the way, about clothes - shop offers are not always the same. Variety of wares is going to change. Just something big enough should happen.
<</if>>\
<<if $p_inv.has("Strange Note#3") || $stash.has("Strange Note#3")>>
	8. Have you ever thought about a trading business? Its quite easy, mind you! You just need: 
   1) find a place to store your cargo, warehouse preferably;
   2) prepare your cargo, you may wanna do it right in a storage place i've mentioned previously! (it's more convenient to do) - for that you need to have a considerable amount of your wares, something like 100 pcs!;
   3) find a distributor! It might be some dropshipper or a large-quantity distributing services provider.
   P.S. You don't really have to pack your wares into cargo, if you are a small trader it might be wiser to work on your connection and a first capital! Just don't forget to turn your capital into more profit.
   9. If you are true dealer - don't be ashamed of trying to sell something in unconventional places! Even in places like gym and various clubs - develop your business skills everywhere!
   10. Streets are peculiarly full of illegal chemical substances nowadays. I wonder, from where do ghetto chemists are getting their supplements? I can imagine you can get some of it on the market, but i dunno how you can get chemical materials for such things without connections in pharmaceuticals circles... or without skills in theft, i guess?
<</if>>\
<<if $p_inv.has("Strange Note#4") || $stash.has("Strange Note#4")>>
   	11. Whenever a new party spot opens in the city, it gets an initial surge in popularity! Well, it's not some big secret - it works the same way with everything in life. But the novelty effect fades quickly.. 
    12. Speaking of which, if this place, figuratively speaking, is stocked with everything it has to offer, it will continue to steadily gain popularity over time!
    13. Higher popularity brings more problems. Isn’t that obvious? It can hurt your reputation and even lead to losses, and more popular the place bigger the losses.
    14. Higher popularity also increases demand for the products you offer. So, the more popular your place, the higher the demand for your goods, and ultimately, the more profit that goes into replenishing your stock.
<</if>>\

passages.name: Brothel
passages.source_raw: <>\ <> <> <> <> <>\ \ <>\ You didn't see a sign or any indication of this wonderful place's name anywhere. Whatever - the purpose of this establishment is obvious. The entrance is decorated in red tones, a sign with a half-naked woman leaves little to the imagination. Inside, there are a lot of women in very provocative clothes scurrying around the men. Yep, that's definitely a brothel. <>\ <> The brothel stands eerily quiet, its former life stripped away. The once-inviting entrance now looks worn, the red tones faded, and the sign of the half-naked woman hangs slightly askew. A small, weathered sign on the door reads "Closed." Inside, the air is thick with dust, and the lavish chaos of before has been replaced with an unsettling emptiness. Whatever this place once was, it's now just a hollow shell. <>\ The brothel is open again - technically. The "Closed" sign is gone, but the atmosphere is far from lively. A few hesitant patrons are lingering in almost empty halls, the furniture looks secondhand, and the walls could use a fresh coat of paint. The place is operational, but luxury is still a distant dream. At least it’s something. <>\ The brothel is regaining its former charm. The red glow of the entrance once again beckons customers inside, and the sign of the half-naked woman has been polished to its former glory. The halls are no longer silent - laughter, music, and the clinking of glasses fill the air. Women in alluring outfits weave through the crowd, and the place finally feels alive again. Business is booming. <>\ This is no longer just a brothel - it’s your brothel, and it shows. The entrance is grand, draped in rich velvets and adorned with an elegant new sign, leaving no doubt about the establishment’s prestige. Inside, the scent of expensive perfume mingles with laughter and music, the atmosphere dripping with indulgence. The women are dressed to impress, the clientele is plentiful, and the money flows like fine wine. This is no longer just a place of pleasure - it’s a monument to your success. <>\ <>\ <>\ Popularity: <>\ <>\ Amount of "workers": $brothel_sluts out of $brothel_sluts_max. <>\ <>\ <> <>\ <>\ <> <= 5 && $accomplices_list.length >= 20>>\ <>\ <>\ <>\ <> <>\ <><> < 0>>\ You can't launch an orgy, you need to wait $brothel_orgy_cd more days\ <>\ You can't launch an orgy, you need more girls working in here\ <>\ You can't launch an orgy, there's not enough people in your gang\ <>\ - <>you can throw an orgy for your crew by putting the brothel’s talents to good use. These wild parties can only happen once every two weeks, last an entire day, and require at least five active workers - and you need to have a gang of twenty or more people to really make it worth it.<> <><><><><> After all, no one’s gonna dare stop you if you want to work in your own establishment, right? <>\ <>\ You really need to go off… and you know someone nearby who can make you squeal easily, and he's not in the brothel right now… huhh… <><><><><> <>\ Maybe you should visit Distributor again... nah, you already had your way with him today. <>\ <>\ <>\ <>\ - "Do you really think that you can barge into a decent establishment and work there right away? No. This place is for the best of the best. And while Cartel holds this place, no random street whore is allowed to work in here."\ <> <>\ <>\ You found Ma sitting alone in the lobby, surrounded by the remnants of a once-thriving establishment. She clutched her chest dramatically, lamenting the state of things. - "Oh, my poor, sweet paradise! Gone, ruined, trampled by those ungrateful little doves! The moment the Cartel lost its grip, they scattered like frightened kittens - took the good sheets with them too!" She sighed, then looked at the you with weary acceptance. "Well, it is what it is. If you plan to rebuild, you'll need new girls and some renovation. Leave the rest to me - I’ll make sure this place shines again." <><> <> <> <> <> <><>\ <> <>\ <><>\ <>\ <>\ <><> <><> <> <><>

passages.source_raw: \ Bank "The Bank" - the only bank in the city. Such an honorable title comes with its responsibilities, and it's evident that the management knows it. Cameras are installed all over this place, metal detectors are placed in all "staff" entry areas, and there’s more than one security guard in the lobby. As for its services: there's a 20% commission rate. Your reputation and solvency will open up new loan opportunities. Note that 5% of any loan is deducted from your paycheck every day. <>\ <>\ - "Are you... no, never mind." - one of the bank workers quickly turned away, hiding her face. For some reason. <>\ Amount of money in your deposit account: $money_deposit​$. You can use the deposit account only once a week, and you can withdraw only 20%, 10%, or 5% of the deposited money in one go. passages.source_raw: \ The Crown Casino. You might want to consider owning your own casino - who knows how much money they launder each day? As a place for entertainment, it’s also impressive. The owner clearly invested heavily, outfitting the place with slot machines, numerous tables for roulette, poker, and blackjack. There’s also a constant presence of security and waitstaff. It’s a cool location. Luckily, you’re not a gambling addict and prefer not to try to cheat the casino, knowing full well that the house always wins. passages.name: Underground Ring
passages.source_raw: \ The underground ring is a sweat-soaked arena hidden beneath the gym, where the stench of adrenaline mixes with the scent of old leather and bad decisions. The walls are lined with various spectators, you can even see some trainers from the gym - some eager, some wary - all with eyes locked on the action. The ring itself is simple but brutal: frayed ropes, stained canvas, and just enough space to get yourself into serious trouble. Here, you can play it safe and place a bet, letting someone else take the hits, or you can throw down $1000 and step into the ring yourself with your team. All melee weapons are allowed, but no beating of surrendered opponent. Reward is a share from the betting pot. You can fight only once per day. The trainers from the gym aren’t just here to cheer from the sidelines - they’ve got a little something extra for the ambitious brawlers. For a hefty price, they’re offering to teach the kind of dirty moves that turn fights around: eye gouges, sucker punches, and all the tricks that’d get you banned from a legit match. <>\ - "$boss_name? The walls are adorned with graffiti, and a couple of neon signs flicker intermittently. Yeah, that's obviously a gang's nest. You steps into the room, where three figures are seated. Biggest (and blackest) figurine looks up to you lazily from his spot on the sofa, his eyes half-closed, yet sharp. - "Ayo, ayo… look who decided to pull up. Heard the chatter ‘bout you. It's time. You've gathered everything you need for this; you've networked and hustled hard to get here. But being a boss is something different. You're going to need to pay a lot of money to your goons, and you'll have to watch out for your reputation. If you lose your grip, you might be overwhelmed by your own troops.

Keep an eye on ''gang morale''. The more dirty jobs and shady businesses you involve your organization in, the bigger the hit to morale. But everything can be fixed with money, and your people will stay loyal as long as you have cash to spare. The lower your gang's morale, the higher the payments you'll have to make every day.

Having your own organization comes with obvious benefits. You'll be able to pursue much bigger scores, like heists and semi-legal businesses. The more money you risk, the more profit you can make.

passages.name: Mafia Leader Fight Intro
passages.source_raw: \ The Suburbs have been a thorn in your side for... long enough. With the Romano mafia clearly weaker than your $band_type, you decide it’s time to end this once and for all. Their estate is eerily quiet as you approach, flanked by your goons. Only a handful of people make any attempt to stop you, mostly verbally, and even Brody waves casually from his garage, as though he couldn’t care less. The Romano mafia is no longer the main power here - and they know it. Inside the mansion, you find Alfa Romano seated in his opulent office, behind a grand desk cluttered with casino chips and playing cards. As you enter, his gaze shifts from surprise to a broad, almost disarming smile, as if you’d never had any beef with him. \ You lay out a simple ultimatum: surrender and work under your organization, or be cast aside entirely. - “You mean... I just hand over a share of my bellissima business to you? Just like that?” He chuckles, shaking his head like it’s the punchline to a private joke. But then his hand lingers near the blackjack deck, his grin turning sharp. “Well, if you think you’re taking my crown without a little spettacolo, think again!” With a sudden burst of energy, <><><><><><><><><><> chips flying everywhere, and lunges at you with the theatrical flair of a man who refuses to bow quietly.

passages.name: CharGen2
passages.source_raw: \ <> - "Burglary, huh? Well, you can keep the tools we found on you. But nothing else." <> - "The car you stole belongs to a gang member. And honestly, I fucking hate that guy. So, consider this car a little present from us - it’ll be parked near your new home." <> - "You’ve made some good profit working as a pimp. That’s why your father wants you to keep… one thousand bucks. Yeah, don’t give me that look - we’re just following his orders." <> - "Take whatever you tried to sell to those poor bastards. I guess you can keep your knife - it’ll come in handy soon enough." <> - "Your previous antics are probably the reason for this farce. I hope you learned a thing or two while you were there, because it’ll be very useful very soon." <>\ The other agent leans forward, his tone sharper now. - "So, about our warning, you're going to thaaat city, y'know, $city_name." They pause for a moment, letting the weight of the name sink in. Everything that you know about this city is that its full of gangs, power struggles, and violence, and has no real order. Tortuga of modern world. Your father was talking about it with his partners in crime, and, if you remember correctly, they wanted to add it to their empire. So, it is how he decided to do it...? - "Have you heard about a huge police crackdown that happened three months ago in $city_name?" - one of the agents broke the silence. You shook your head. - "Basically, one raid changed everything. Gangs were fractured, businesses shut down, prison cells are overflowing. This is a free real estate right now. And someone from your family, you know, someone who SAVES you all the time, wants you to prove yourself. And he says that you're ready for that. But i'll be honest, odds are against you." - He pauses, giving you a pointed look. - "And now, you’re going to be thrown into that mess. Your job? Setup your own gang in $city_name. Restore some kind of control. Or at least the money flow. The methods are up to you. No one will judge, do whatever it takes. We'll assist you if you get yourself in trouble, police chief of $city_name is our guy. And you'll getting yourself your very own apartments... in a basement. Any questions?" <> - "There are still four gangs in $city_name. This number used to be seven, but three of them merged into one strong organization simply called ''The Gangs''. Their main sources of income are racketeering and burglary. They control the Old Downtown, the previous city center, but right now, it’s more of a ghetto. The police didn’t stop at just finishing the crackdown - they secured a federal grant and brought in private investors to create a new, fortified city center. They took over what used to be a residential district, cleaned it up, and turned it into a haven for law-abiding citizens." - "Then there’s the ''Mafia''. Not the real one, obviously, just some poseurs. They mainly deal with stolen cars, and there are rumors about an underground fight ring under their control. Their area of operation is in the suburbs of $city_name." - "And then there are the ''Bikers'' and the ''Cartel''. We don’t know much about the bikers, other than that they work as couriers and transport stuff around. They also deal in weapons, selling to literally anyone. It’s a big mystery to me why we haven’t shut them down already. As for the Cartel... The ''Cartel'' isn’t a local gang, not by a long shot. You know about the Cartel, right? The Cartel is a major trading organization that acts as an intermediary between sellers and buyers. Most likely, they’re interested in the city itself, which is why they have a representative here. The Cartel isn’t your problem. Do not, I repeat, do not do anything foolish with them." <> <> - "Do whatever you can. I’m pretty sure you know the drill. Start with something small, but we’re not gonna teach you how to make money illegally. Just be mindful of how you get your cash - if it’s dirty money, clean it before using it, or the IRS will come after you, and we won’t be able to save you in that case. You can launder your money by funneling it into legal enterprises... That’s all I’m gonna say." <> <> - "Your father asked himself this question in his time, which is why he asked us to leave you a whiteboard with some tasks to help set you up. It’ll be at your place." <> <> - "Build your reputation and your wealth. Everything you do will affect your rep. Also, try to meet all the important people in the city first, just to know what your options are. Probably its wise to start from the Old Downtown." <> <> <>\

passages.source_raw: You’ve been a naughty girl, playing with fire, smoking, playing with knives... Not everyone in your family approved of your behavior, but it wasn’t reprehensible in such circles. +1 combat.

passages.name: Adolesence info Leader
passages.source_raw: No one in your circle of friends had any doubt that you were the boss. Most of your friends are from other families tied to criminal, and being their leader is in your blood. +1 charm.

passages.name: Adolesence info Curious
passages.source_raw: You always have been trying to get your nose into family business, even though adults do not allowed you to do so. But because of that you know something about things that are better to keep secret. +1 cunning.

passages.name: Crime info Robbery
passages.source_raw: Assaulting people with knives and various sports equipment is your way of doing business. You know how to collect money from debtors, and it was your first duty for your father’s empire. You’re not joking, and people around you should know that. +1 combat.

passages.name: Crime info Theft
passages.source_raw: You had access to one of the biggest treasuries in the world, but you wanted to build your own treasure trove. Your first theft was pretty petty, but you tasted the thrill and excitement. It’s almost like a gambling addiction when you’re opening a new wallet, and you’re still a long way from your "one last score." +1 cunning.

passages.name: Crime info Romance fraud
passages.source_raw: You’ve been seducing people for your own pleasure and wealth. Manipulation, fraud, framing - it’s all part of your arsenal. It’s quite easy to seduce people when your father is a crime lord and you’re quite pretty yourself. +1 charm.

passages.name: Last Crime info Burglary
passages.source_raw: You’ve been caught for burglary. Your target was a wealthy house in a posh district. Even though you knew how to deal with home security systems and how to distract a dog, you got busted. +2 cunning and 5 lockpicks. Each lockpick allows you to enter a house.

passages.name: Last Crime info Grand Theft Auto
passages.source_raw: You’ve stolen a car. It wasn’t the greatest ride, and it’s definitely not worth a prison term, but you’ve been experimenting, trying out different thievery techniques. Who knew it was so easy to track a car, even after a plate and color change? +2 cunning and car. The car unlocks fast travel.

passages.name: Last Crime info Den
passages.source_raw: You’ve organized a drug distribution den. Everything went smoothly - you got rid of the squatters in a shady project in the ghetto, convinced some family contacts to prepare the drug supplies, and even hired a few muscle, but you can't trust desperate drug addicts. One day, they just turned you in to the police. +1 charm, +1 cunning, 50 drugs right from the start. You can distribute it on various streets and locations.

passages.name: Last Crime info Armed Robbery
passages.source_raw: You’ve been doing business behind your father’s back. Well, it’s hard to call your deals very enterprise-like; you’ve been robbing people in shady alleys and setting toll prices in “bad” districts. It was bound to end like this one day, anyway. +2 combat and 1000$.

passages.name: Last Crime info Pimping
passages.source_raw: You’ve been a ma for some girls under the protection of your father’s organization, so your role was simply to find clients for them. And it wasn’t easy. You had to deal with hysterics, rude and hesitant clients, and handle the various consequences. One of the dissatisfied clients turned you in to the police. +2 charm, 1000$ right from the start.

passages.name: Last Crime info Underground Fight
passages.source_raw: You’ve been a pit fighter. Your new hobby really annoys your family, but you don’t care at all. You wouldn’t be surprised if it was your father who told the cops to raid your underground ring. +2 combat, first combat trait right from the start with additional 5 health poinst.

<<widget "nc_calculations">>\
<<silently>>/
<<set $nc_pop_raise = 0>>
/* POPULARITY PENALTIES */
<<if $nc_pop >= 0 && $nc_pop < 20>>
	<<set $nc_pop_raise = 1>>
<<elseif $nc_pop >= 20 && $nc_pop < 50>>
	<<set $nc_pop_raise = 0>>
<<elseif $nc_pop >= 50 && $nc_pop < 75>>
	<<set $nc_pop_raise = -1>>
<<elseif $nc_pop >= 75>>
	<<set $nc_pop_raise = -2>>
<</if>>

/* ENTRANCE PRICE */
<<if $nc_entrance_price == 5>>
	<<set $nc_pop_raise += 1>>
<<elseif $nc_entrance_price == 15>>
	<<set $nc_pop_raise -= 1>>
<</if>>

/* DRINKS */
<<set $nc_capacity_drinks_use = $nc_pop * 5>>
<<if $nc_capacity_drinks < $nc_capacity_drinks_use>>
	<<set $nc_pop_raise -= 1>>
<</if>>

/* DRUGS */
<<if $nc_backrooms_deals == true>>
    <<set $nc_capacity_drugs_use = $nc_pop * 4>>
    <<if $nc_capacity_drugs > $nc_capacity_drugs_use>>
        <<set $nc_pop_raise += 1>>
    <</if>>
<</if>>

/* RISKS */
<<set $nc_risks = ($nc_pop * 3)>>
<<set _risk_effect =  ($nc_risks / 100) * $nc_risk_percentage_mod>>
<<set $nc_risks -= _risk_effect>>
<<set $nc_risks = Math.trunc($nc_risks)>>

/* MAINTENANCE */
<<set $nc_tax = 500 + $nc_tax_upgrades>>
<<set $nc_tax += 200 * $nc_drinks_autobuy>>

/* INCOME */
<<if $nc_capacity_drinks < $nc_capacity_drinks_use>>
	<<set $nc_income = ($nc_entrance_price * $nc_pop) * 5>>\
<<else>>
	<<set $nc_income = ($nc_entrance_price * $nc_pop) + (50 * $nc_pop)>>\
<</if>>
<<if $nc_capacity_drugs > $nc_capacity_drugs_use && $nc_backrooms_deals == true>>
	<<set $nc_income += $nc_capacity_drugs_use * 12>>
<</if>>
<<if $nc_drugdealer_event == true>>
	<<set _nc_drugdealer_toll = random(150, 300)>>
    <<set $nc_income += _nc_drugdealer_toll>>
<</if>>
<<set $nc_laundry = (100 * $nc_pop) + $nc_laundry_mod>>\

/* INCOME OSCILLATION */
<<if $nc_income < 500>>
	<<set $nc_oscillation = random(0, 200)>>
<<elseif $nc_income < 1000>>
	<<set $nc_oscillation = random(-300, 300)>>
<<elseif $nc_income < 2000>>
	<<set $nc_oscillation = random(-600, 600)>>
<<elseif $nc_income < 4000>>
	<<set $nc_oscillation = random(-1000, 1000)>>
<<elseif $nc_income < 8000>>
	<<set $nc_oscillation = random(-2000, 2000)>>
<<elseif $nc_income >= 8000>>
	<<set $nc_oscillation = random(-3000, 3000)>>
<</if>>

/* THINGS FROM UPGRADES */
<<if $nc_stripper_poles == true>>
	<<set $nc_pop_raise += 1>>
<</if>>
\
<<if $nc_gloryhole_booths == true>>
<<set $nc_gloryhole_sluts = 0>>
<<for _i = 0; _i < $sluts_list.length; _i++>>\
	<<if $sluts_list[_i].work_location == "Gloryhole">>
    	<<set $nc_gloryhole_sluts ++>>
    <</if>>
<</for>>
    <<if $nc_pop < 15>>
        <<set _gloryhole_earnings = $nc_gloryhole_sluts * random(80, 160)>>
        <<set _gloryhole_max_earnings = $nc_gloryhole_sluts * 160>>
    <<elseif $nc_pop >= 15 && $nc_pop < 30>>
        <<set _gloryhole_earnings = $nc_gloryhole_sluts * random(100, 190)>>
        <<set _gloryhole_max_earnings = $nc_gloryhole_sluts * 190>>
    <<elseif $nc_pop >= 30 && $nc_pop < 50>>
        <<set _gloryhole_earnings = $nc_gloryhole_sluts * random(120, 220)>>
        <<set _gloryhole_max_earnings = $nc_gloryhole_sluts * 220>>
    <<elseif $nc_pop >= 50 && $nc_pop < 75>>
        <<set _gloryhole_earnings = $nc_gloryhole_sluts * random(140, 250)>>
        <<set _gloryhole_max_earnings = $nc_gloryhole_sluts * 250>>
    <<elseif $nc_pop >= 75>>
        <<set _gloryhole_earnings = $nc_gloryhole_sluts * random(160, 300)>>
        <<set _gloryhole_max_earnings = $nc_gloryhole_sluts * 300>>
    <</if>>
<</if>>

<</silently>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "change_entrance_price">>\
<<if $nc_entrance_price == 5>>\
	<<link "+" "NightClub Info">>
    	<<set $nc_entrance_price = 10>>\
    <</link>>\
<<elseif $nc_entrance_price == 10>>\
	<<link "+"  "NightClub Info">>
    	<<set $nc_entrance_price = 15>>\
    <</link>>\
    <<link "-"  "NightClub Info">>
    	<<set $nc_entrance_price = 5>>\
    <</link>>\
<<elseif $nc_entrance_price == 15>>\
	<<link "-"  "NightClub Info">>
    	<<set $nc_entrance_price = 10>>\
    <</link>>\
<</if>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "change_drinks_autobuy">>\
<<link "+" "NightClub Info">>\
	<<set $nc_drinks_autobuy += 1>>\
<</link>>\
<<link "-" "NightClub Info">>\
	<<set $nc_drinks_autobuy -= 1>>\
<</link>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "change_lab_percentage">>\
<<if $nc_lab_percentage >= 0 && $nc_lab_percentage <= 95>>\
<<link "+">>\
	<<set $nc_lab_percentage += 5>>\
    <<run Engine.show()>>\
<</link>>\
<</if>>\
<<if $nc_lab_percentage >= 5 && $nc_lab_percentage <= 100>>\
<<link "-">>\
	<<set $nc_lab_percentage -= 5>>\
    <<run Engine.show()>>\
<</link>>\
<</if>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "change_moonshine_percentage">>\
<<if $nc_moonshine_percentage >= 0 && $nc_moonshine_percentage <= 95>>\
<<link "+">>\
	<<set $nc_moonshine_percentage += 5>>\
    <<run Engine.show()>>\
<</link>>\
<</if>>\
<<if $nc_moonshine_percentage >= 5 && $nc_moonshine_percentage <= 100>>\
<<link "-">>\
	<<set $nc_moonshine_percentage -= 5>>\
    <<run Engine.show()>>\
<</link>>\
<</if>>\
<</widget>>\

<<widget "nc_newday">>
<<nc_pop `$nc_pop_raise`>>

<<if $nc_capacity_drinks >= $nc_capacity_drinks_use>>
	<<nc_capacity_drinks `-$nc_capacity_drinks_use`>>
<</if>>
<<set $nc_capacity_drinks += $nc_drinks_autobuy * 100>>

<<if $nc_capacity_drugs > $nc_capacity_drugs_use && $nc_backrooms_deals == true>>
	<<nc_capacity_drugs `-$nc_capacity_drugs_use`>>
<</if>>
<<if $p_lab_nc_prod == true>>
	<<set $nc_capacity_drugs += $nc_lab_prod>>
<</if>>
<</widget>>

''Version: 0.22.0: Brick by Brick'' <>\ v0.22.0 New implementations: New images: girls got 15 more images in each category, and "mid"-tier guys got ~40 more images. Presumably, all actions that require stamina are now displayed with an icon. There might still be some copy-paste errors. NPC "type" (i.e. Thug/Thief/Traveler/Civ) is now displayed via icons. They also grant much less friendship, and the boss may gain depravity depending on the partner. Added the ability to mark NPCs as "important" in their window. This marks them with a star in the contacts list. All link icons now have tooltips. Mostly useful for stamina actions and skillchecks if you're new, but still. All movement actions within a district now take only 5 minutes. Streamlined! Changed descriptions to some house upgrades, mostly added what they unlock next. Added a T3 house requirement to the "Armory" upgrade. Added missing NPC jobs to the job filter. The "crew" event where a random person shows up and starts asserting themselves will be removed from the event pool once you reach the "Big Boss" reputation tier. The "crew" event where crew members argue will be removed from the event pool if morale is above 80. Added a new "crew" event where a member tries to get a friend hired at somewhat legal stuff. You can assign them to any "worker" job. Added a new "crew" event where a member tries to get a friend hired for a legit job. You can assign them to any "worker" position. New "rich" NPC type: Industrialist. Sells gun parts and junk in bulk. Removed expensive crypto from gig rewards and slightly rebalanced the remaining rewards, while increasing cash payouts. Street events now have a small cooldown at the start of the game (3-8 days). Wardrobe descriptions were cleaned up - less clutter now. Removed the "trait" filter due to new icons. Added more media, mostly for the actions used in new quickies. Fixes: Fixed quickies increasing the partner count stat even when repeated with the same person. Fixed pawnshop giving money for cellphones without removing them from inventory. Fixed broken enemy generation at the junkyard. Added a list of girls working at the streaming hub to the whiteboard. Fixed incorrect info about the max number of girls in upgraded downtown and harbor strolls. Fixed issues in the NPC debug menu. v0.21.0 New implementations Photos! Well, images. They were added to every NPC and to the most interactions with NPCs: meeting, bargaining, talking, the contacts window, bodyguard stats, strolls, combat, calls, etc. Images for male NPCs are chosen depending on their wealth stat. Images for female NPCs are chosen randomly: they can be brunettes, blondes, or redheads. Blondes are slightly rarer than brunettes, and redheads are slightly rarer than blondes. Maybe this will become important later. Images for special NPCs are also shown in the menu. Images for girls and special NPCs are taken from royalty-free photo libraries and were cropped where needed. Images for male NPCs are AI-generated. Sorry, but it was too hard to find a selection of freaks (the poorest NPCs) large enough in royalty-free libraries. I've tried. There are also images for all possible combat enemies. Beauty shop in the mall - includes a new set of wearable items: earrings, nails, and piercings. Piercings modify arousal gain. The beauty shop is locked behind the "Brand Emporium" store unlock. There's also a hairdresser in the beauty shop. The Boss can change her hair color and "look" in there, obviously. Hair color and "look" can be chosen from a small selection of available options at the start of the game. Other changes The banner and reputation icons have been replaced with a PC image. Added the ability to set the Boss's name in place of the reputation tier in the sidebar after reaching the "Rogue Boss" reputation tier. Toggleable in the Code on the whiteboard. Modified the UI for combat encounters - it now shows images of the Boss, her bodyguards, and enemies. Gangers now offer a new service - they can provide thug/thief recruits until the first 1000 gang strength. All recruits are low-tier mobs, but they'll do for the beginning. They also serve as a kind of tutorial/explanation. All weapons now have a 2-turn cooldown. Added the ability to equip weapons to bodyguards through the "Stats" menu. Added the ability to choose a specific target for boosters on the whiteboard. Previously this was only possible through direct interaction. Renamed the NPC "trait" to "specialization". The biker heat-reduction service is now slightly randomized (25%-35%). A few text tweaks here and there: made the formatting of all first meetings with gang leaders more consistent, removed the hint about the weapon shipment in the pre-gang whiteboard and colorized some money values. Fixes Fixed a few missing combat resets (in gym and burglar encounters) that could lead to broken targeting. Fixed a missing stylishness check that prevented gaining 2 charm points. v0.20.0 New implementations: Junkyard - new location on the outskirts. Boss can rummage there for some junk and occasional cheap loot, with a possibility that local hobos will attack. Scrap shack - new business that can be built on the junkyard. Starts off as a junk-gathering "biz" and can be upgraded to an arms manufacturing operation. Includes manual weapons crafting and automatic crafting, with the ability to set every gun to craft automatically until X amount. Requires loaders as workers (so-called scrap hands) and one gunsmith. The gunsmith can be recruited by hiring an engineer NPC. Gun Parts - new crafting component. Scrap hands at the shack can produce these from junk passively. The amount of desired gun parts in stock can be set manually. Used, obviously, for weapons crafting. Junk handgun, junk rifle, junk autogun - new weapons made out of junk, craftable at the scrap shack. No way to obtain these outside of it for now. Improvised Weapons Shipment - new shipment made from junk guns. Has a slightly lower heat increase for trading, but still yields a sizeable profit. Other changes: Changing to a penetrative sex pose during "main" sex with male NPCs now plays a video of pulling panties down. Variations depend on who changed the pose (PC or NPC). Bikers no longer sell rifles, only handguns and gun parts. The amount of handguns and gun parts is limited, but if Boss looks slutty enough, the weapon dealer can offer a small restock if there are no more gun parts or handguns. Includes new media. Full restock takes one week. Thieves’ accomplices now bring some junk alongside their usual loot. Low-tier combat encounters now yield some junk alongside usual loot. High-tier combat encounters now yield some gun parts alongside usual loot. Web weapons market now occasionally sells gun parts. Crew arming event that previously required one weapon shipment now requires 10 handguns of any type. Junk handguns will lower morale though. Safe cracking now yields some gun parts. Warehouse burglary and warehouse heist now include gun parts in their loot tables. Slightly increased loot from warehouse heist. Added the ability to sell up to 5 weapon shipments to bikers without raising heat if they are captured. Convenience store heist now yields some junk too. Buffed coin washers’ accomplices, now they can wash up to "300 * combat" cash. Removed "Lawyer" NPCs, both female and male. Added "Businesswoman" NPC job. Added "Businessman" NPCs to harbor spawns. Added "Engineer" NPCs to City Center and Suburbs. I may rename them, now that i'm thinking about it, since there are "hardware engineer" and "engineer" NPCs with two different utilities... Businessmen and businesswomen can now help with a kickback scheme, allowing to wash a moderate amount of dirty cash. Only once per NPC though. Number boxes slightly enlarged because they looked weird with more than 5 digits. Increase base stamina by 2. Removed 1 stamina increase from "fitness" perk. New "Junk Rat" trait, acquired by scavenging junk at the junkyard. Provides 2 additional stamina. Changed trait gain descriptions to be clearer, now all of them are explicitly state what they provide. Added the ability to fire any non-accomplice worker via the whiteboard. Hid all staff management stuff on locations behind hidden text. Added new shipment order for an improvised weapons shipment. Changed "Request from Banana Republic" to also include an improvised weapons shipment. Fix: Fixed broken <> macro during the framing gig. v0.19.1 New implementations: "Ironman" mode that disables saving everywhere except the home area, disables the "Back" sidebar button, and blocks all cheats (including the Patreon debug panel, ofc). It can be chosen at the start of the game or via the cheat panel. The mode can only be toggled once every 21 ingame days. Not exactly a true ironman mode, since it can still be turned on and off tho... Added a dice icon to all actions that do not have a guaranteed outcome. Basically, an icon for skill checks. Clarity! Other changes: Increased maximum NPC skill levels to 15. New phrasing for the action that provides police connections. I forgot it was originally intended only for getting accomplices out of jail. Slightly increased prices for moonshine trading in bar and income for drugs distribution in park. Fix: Fixed missing initialization of the security room upgrade, which made it impossible to obtain it on new saves. The fix will also be automatically applied to existing save files. v0.19.0 New implementations: "The Long Count" heist - bank robbery Heist focused on time, hostages, and hostage stress management. Each turn takes 1 minute and rolls a safecracker skill check that increases heist progress and final score. At some point gunner will begin rolling his own skillchecks too. Each turn requires resolving an event that depends on hostages' stress. No smut in this heist, though. Score can be taken at any time, but high progress unlocks a cash-grab minigame with top rewards. Losing all hostages or running out of time fails the heist. Starting time and hostages can be increased via police connections and banker intel. New location: Beach at the Harbor New spot to meet NPCs or sell drugs. Has, of course, its own "caught" event. Dominant NPCs may try to pick up the Boss when trying to meet new people. Other changes: "Traveler" NPCs can now take some heat onto themselves and leave the city for a price. Has a cooldown. "Sailor" NPCs can now sell random shipments. Has a cooldown. "Traveler", "Sailor", "Policeman", "Jeweler", and "Banker" male NPCs who previously had any intimate relationship with the Boss may now request additional "favors" when using their services. The type of favor depends on their dominance. New house upgrade available after the security room: Armory. Significantly increases gang strength. New gang upgrade: Armored Vehicles, available from the weapon market on the web. Also significantly increases gang strength. Casino heist is now locked behind gang strength, same as the bank heist. New UI for the heisting menu. Daily heist intel gained from scouts reduced by 50%. Intel requirement for the casino heist adjusted accordingly (slightly lowered). Reputation gain from selling "stuff" on the streets lowered to 8-15 per action. Chance to get caught while selling "stuff" increased from 10% to 15%. All NPC service prices are now colorized. Slightly more media added across various events. Partner-related statistics now check NPC's data before any changes. If the Boss already had intimate relations with an NPC, the stat will not increase. This should apply to everything: calls, special events, debtor-related content, special NPCs, etc. Travelers do not spawn anymore in the City Center. Fixes: Fixed incorrect display of experience percentage for the kinky trait. Fixed missing experience gain for the kinky trait when performing certain activities with girls. Fixed missing media in the nightclub event while gathering information about gang location. v0.18.0 New implementations: Returned the ability to wield and use weapons in combat. Equipping a weapon replaces the "kick" action with the appropriate weapon skill. Weapon effects work the same way as they do for bodyguards. Added a new capturable spot called the "Checkpoint". It is located in the outskirts and is controlled by bikers at the start of the game. Its location is initially hidden and can be discovered in four ways: through hackers, by "asking nicely" the biker leader, by purchasing the moonshine trailer, or by fully conquering the bikers. One way or another, it cannot be missed. The checkpoint is hidden because it is essentially an infinite shipment generator - one shipment every two days - guarded by and attacked with potentially the strongest enemy spawns in the game. Added the ability to set auto-resupply up to a specified resource amount for the brothel and nightclub directly from the warehouse. Added an option to invite any accomplice to the bedroom, provided gang rules allow it. This initiates a "main" scene with them and grants a small morale boost to the crew. Added new breast-focused actions during "main" scenes, both for the Boss and her partners. Added new actions for NPC partners - they may attempt to spread someone's cheeks during doggystyle and missionary positions. These actions were also added to existing scenes where appropriate. Other changes: Added a lot more media - roughly 100 new videos. Notably expanded shower, maid, main pose, and sex action sets, along with smaller additions across many other categories. v0.17.0 New implementations: Ability to assault any NPC. Still deciding if it should be locked behind some relationship level, but right now it's free for all. Loot depends on the NPC's wealth level, and richer NPCs will call for help from random passersby. Assaulting either poor or rich NPCs will significantly increase heat. After every combat win, bodyguards may request a "reward" if that kind of stuff is allowed in the crew. The more rewards they receive, for more they'll ask. Every accomplice has a hidden counter for this. Works for one or two bodyguards accordingly. Bodyguard commentaries. Indoors-only, and can be muted in the "Character" menu. New UI for crew hierarchy management. Everyone can be assigned to any position directly on the whiteboard, and roles are divided by required member type (thug or thief). Other changes: Map now shows if anything is under attack, such as strolls or blocks captured by other gangs. It also shows statuses of capturable businesses, currently only strolls. The map link will show a notification if something is under attack. More mid and high-tier clothing. Better UI for bodyguards in the "Character" menu. Added missing icons for new locations. More media for almost all types of finishers. Separated media for MFM threesomes. Double-action is now its own category with more content. Generic MFM "double-action" currently appears only in events with bodyguards, night visits from crew members, and nightclub call events. Pop-up videos for removing a bu*tplug before sleep and inserting it in the morning. New upgrades for the brothel and 404 bleach that increase the number of girls working the local stroll. Changed formatting for location links to make them less inconsistent. Colorized all monetary rewards in combat results. Added a Back button on the sidebar to all home-related passages, returning you to the main home screen. Increased maximum heat to 125 percent. Now you can’t fully evade a heat event if heat hit 100 percent during the day but reduction was high. You can still counter it if your reduction is extremely high tho. Added more cheats to the cheat passage and debug panel. Increased health and combat stats of nearly all enemies by about 10-15%. Fixes: You can no longer loot a junkie’s hands in the Dark Alley. Added strolls to the condition that hides the income breakdown. Fixed missing media in the downtown "duo" event. Fixed missing time loss when waiting at strolls and added missing stamina requirements. Fixed missing tax increase for the brothel from the VIP booths upgrade. v0.16.0 New implementations: Combat Rework Combat is now a turn-based autobattler. The Boss only picks targets and has a very limited set of abilities. Up to three enemies can fight the Boss at once, and the Boss can bring companions (bodyguards). The idea behind the rework is that combat will be more about preparation than about the battle itself (which was weak before). With strong bodyguards, you can simply click through encounters. Turn order depends on cunning, damage scales with combat. Status effects kept: stun, bleeding. New status: weakness - reduces outgoing damage of whoever has it. A large portion of melee weapon perks was rewritten. All melee weapons are now companion-only, the Boss no longer swings knives. New home upgrade that increases companions’ max HP and regeneration. Bodyguard stats and HP display toggle can be found in the character menu. Combat rewards reworked: Enemies drop their weapons. Money reward now scales from a reputation-based variable instead of combat. All combat encounters were rebalanced and adapted to the new combat system, most of combat events can no longer be cleared without bodyguards. The combat trait gained from participating in fights was updated to match the new mechanics. Prologue bonuses related to combat were updated as well. NPCs now spawn with a random HP amount (revealed with the observer trait), helping you pick better potential bodyguards. NPCs can also spawn with weapons. Strolls Every district except Outskirts and City Center now has a prostitution spot (“stroll”). Owning a stroll lets you assign your team to it, operating a stroll requires a pimp and working girls. All strolls start controlled by the gang that owns the district. Spot must be captured first if you want to assign a team. After capturing a stroll, an invisible timer starts, "grace period". When it completes, there's gonna be a chance roll everyday that someone will attack the spot. If you ignore the attack and the district is still not under your control, the stroll returns to the enemy gang. If the district is under your control, the stroll simply becomes blocked. Capturing the same stroll from the same gang three times in a row triggers a gang war. If the Boss controls the district, she can simply take the stroll from whoever holds it. There's also a late-game toggle that delegates stroll issues to the gang. Besides attacks, strolls can generate problems the pimp must solve, whether the pimp succeeds depends on their combat and dominance. New nightclub upgrade that unlocks a City Center stroll. This one does not require a pimp and gets an income bonus based on club popularity. The Boss can also personally work the stroll. Income depends on outfit sluttiness and charm. There are 9 client events total, each with Timid and Kinky variants (small act variations, not huge description variety, sorry, i had time constraints). Districts use their own pool of 3 client types. Quick descriptions of events: "Motel", "Limo", "Black", "Two blacks", "Outdoors", "Car", "Restroom in night club", "Home A", "Pool". Client events reuse existing scenes scattered through the game, yeah. Working the stroll has a two-tier trait increasing stroll income, charm, and stamina. Other Changes: Added new media for pool, limo, and everything related to blacks. Limo event now has both traditional and not-so-sex variants. Pool event now has an extended "warm-up" sequence at high arousal. Everything listed above is used in stroll too, yeah. Prices reduced for many expensive home upgrades and club-related upgrades. And, uh, club itself is even more cheaper. Active gigs now disappear after three days if ignored. Temporary top-position close button added to contacts. Not pretty, i know, i'll replace it later, but its still better than scrolling down. Added description of depravity and an explanation of how it works to the demeanor menu. Fix: Fixed thieves turning into thugs when recruited with benefits. v0.15.1 Fixes: Broken event description setter for mid-level depravity. Broken reverse action during on-top pose. v0.15.0 New implementations: Two new poses for the naughty times in the bedroom: Oral-oriented pose with two actions for the Boss and three reactions for her partner. Highly dominant NPCs can refuse switching to this pose. "On top" pose with two variations, a "reverse" action, and three reactions for the NPC. While on top, the Boss can freely switch the variation without asking the NPC first. Descriptors and media: More descriptors for everything sex-related: commentaries from bystanders in restrooms and outside events, more descriptors for each depravity stage of the player during each type of "generic" sex event. New mid stage of depravity for descriptors, when the player is neither low nor high to be eager. Much more media in general (~100 videos), most of them for the new poses though. Arrays of "generic" media are still used in many events, not only during intimate time with NPCs, sooo... yeah, overall, it'll be used everywhere.
